title: Font delivery program
description: Which font programs deliver the contract's typography role slots (tokens/base.css §2, spec tokens/semantic.md §2, reference contract/typography.md). One entry per theme adapter in themes/. The CSS side of each entry is fonts/theme-<name>.fonts.css.

policy.rule: The registry never fetches a font. Theme font files declare FAMILY STACKS only — no @import, no @font-face src pointing at a remote host — so a consumer under a strict CSP (the showroom, dist/*.html, published artifacts) renders correctly with zero network requests. A consumer who licenses/self-hosts a named webfont adds its own @font-face with a local path; the stack already names the family first, so it takes over with no token change.
policy.fallbackRule: Every stack degrades to a system family. A licensed face that the registry may not distribute is named FIRST and followed by the shipped tier, so its absence is a graceful downgrade rather than a broken slot.

shadcn.title: shadcn neutral
shadcn.voice: Whatever the OS ships. The character is in the neutrality: no downloaded face, no branded display tier, headings and body share one stack.

display.stack: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
display.resolvesTo: SF Pro (macOS/iOS) · Segoe UI Variable (Windows) · Roboto (Android) · system UI font (Linux)
display.licensing: none required — OS-resident faces, never redistributed by the registry
display.note: Same stack as body by design (--family-display is the alias source; --family-body points at it).

code.stack: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

optional.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — redistributable, self-hosting permitted
optional.howTo: Self-host the woff2 files, add your own @font-face, then prepend "Geist" to --family-display in your app CSS. Declared in theme-shadcn.json capabilities.fonts as an allowed option; the registry does not ship or fetch it.
optional.fallback: system sans stack (identical metrics class: neutral grotesque)

typeRoleNotes.action: case none, tracking 0em, weight 500 — shadcn's button voice is plain sentence-case UI text (themes/theme-shadcn.json tokens.typeRoles.action).
typeRoleNotes.sizes: Fixed rem scale — shadcn declares density: false, so no role size is variable.

salt.title: Salt DS
salt.voice: Open Sans everywhere, PT Mono for figures, and the uppercase-600-tracked action role that is Salt's single most recognisable signature. Display tiers were designed in Amplitude, which is licensed and cannot ship.

display.licensing: RESTRICTED — Amplitude (Font Bureau) is a commercially licensed typeface. It is NOT shipped, NOT fetched, and NOT redistributable by this registry. It is named first in the stack so a licensee who self-hosts it gets Salt's true display voice; everyone else falls through to Open Sans automatically.
display.fallback: Open Sans, then the system sans stack
display.recordedIn: themes/theme-salt.json tokens.typeRoles.heading — "600 Open Sans (display tiers: Amplitude, licensed)"

body.licensing: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — free to use and self-host, including commercially. Not bundled here (stacks-only policy); a consumer self-hosts the four weights and the stack picks them up.
body.selfHostNote: Self-host woff2 for weights 300/400/600/700 (normal + italic if prose needs it). Do not add a remote @import — it breaks the registry's CSP guarantee.

code.stack: "PT Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
code.licensing: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — free to self-host. Not bundled here.
code.note: Carries the data role: Salt renders tabular figures in PT Mono (themes/theme-salt.json tokens.typeRoles.data — "PT Mono tabular").

typeRoleNotes.action: case UPPERCASE, tracking 0.6px, weight 600 — declared non-configurable in themes/theme-salt.json constraints. Delivered through the contract slots --type-action / --action-case / --action-tracking.
typeRoleNotes.label: 600 at the density-driven UI size (theme-salt.json typeRoles.label: "600 11px" at high density).
typeRoleNotes.sizes: Chrome roles (label, action, data) bind to --text-ui, which the density axis rescales (high/medium/low/touch). Prose roles (body, caption, headings) are fixed so reading text does not shrink with control density.
